objectives.statement: Choose wording that fits professional and conversational situations in Norwegian.

notes: High-risk register topic. Must teach modern Bokmål as situational tone rather than ceremonial formal speech: du/dere are the normal defaults, De/Dem/Deres are rare and marked, and greetings, directness, colloquial markers, sentence style, and word choice carry professional, neutral, or conversational tone. Treat Hei as normal in professional email; avoid making Norwegian sound more legalistic or ceremonious than it is.
